title: AAA benchmark v2.1 - repaired measurement protocol

randomness.description: Every trial stream is derived from SeedSequence([root_seed, purpose, family, replica, episode]) where purpose is a frozen confirmation batch identity or the literal development purpose. Allocation depends only on trial identity, never on worker scheduling order.

candidate.boundary_policy: observation-only scalar reflection of the predicted position, and the inverse of the same public map applied to the update target so the learner regresses in the coordinate its own linear law lives in; programmed public knowledge of the observation format, not a learned capability
candidate.self_triggered_forgetting: forgetting is applied only on steps whose own a-priori normalized error exceeds max(detector_multiplier * ewma(|error|), detector_floor), where the running scale is tracked from unsurprising steps only. The trigger is the model's own scored prediction error; the evaluator never signals an event, a scenario or a mode switch.

training.distribution_relationship: in-domain: the training speed range equals the confirmation speed range. Deliberate extrapolation is measured separately by the labelled speed_extrapolation family.

constant_velocity.description: In-domain constant velocity. Episodes are deliberately allocated across the full direction x position x speed product so required coverage is known before any result is observed.

bouncing.description: Constant speed with wall reflection. Reflected constant motion is analytically exact here, so this family measures whether the candidate matches a known-correct rule, not whether it discovers boundary behaviour.

speed_change.description: Unannounced speed-magnitude change under an unchanged constant-velocity law. The frozen arm is a robustness control; a separate updating arm is reported so a frozen result is never described as adaptation.

always_online.description: Continuous deployment track. One candidate instance keeps predicting and learning across a rotation of regimes with no evaluator-provided mode switch, scenario label, event flag or reset.

speed_extrapolation.description: Labelled out-of-distribution stress track: speeds strictly above the training range. Reported, not required.

changed_law.equations: a[t] = -2*zeta*omega*v[t] - omega^2*(x[t]-m); v[t+1] = v[t] + a[t]*dt; x[t+1] = reflect(x[t] + v[t+1]*dt)
changed_law.description: Fixed canonical intervention timing at the end of the common prefix, chosen for exact causal alignment between the frozen and updating branches; the post-change coefficients are sampled per episode from the declared ranges. Timing is fixed and is described as fixed, not as randomized.

estimands.relative_improvement: 1 - mean_over_resampled_episodes(candidate) / mean_over_resampled_episodes(baseline); the interval recomputes exactly this ratio-of-means on every draw
estimands.resampling_units: level 1 = training replica with replacement; level 2 = that replica's own episode summaries with replacement, preserving its observation count; episode pairing across predictors is preserved

gates.name: stratum_coverage
gates.description: Every required direction x position x speed stratum is present with the declared minimum episode and replica counts; both walls are observed; bounce and eligible change events meet their minimums.

gates.name: constant_velocity_identification
gates.description: The candidate identifies the constant-velocity law: in-domain straight-motion normalized MAE and per-stratum p95 stay inside the declared absolute limits. This is an accuracy claim about a specific law, not a claim that learning occurred.

gates.name: learning_progress
gates.description: Frozen checkpoints taken at increasing cumulative update budgets are scored on one fixed development probe bank. The gate requires a large measured reduction from the zero-initialized checkpoint, with a hierarchical bootstrap lower bound. A parameterless analytic rule cannot satisfy it because it has no budgets and no parameter change.

gates.name: frozen_prediction_accuracy
gates.description: Frozen generalization to the unfamiliar bouncing regime stays inside a declared absolute accuracy limit.

gates.name: bounce_event_accuracy
gates.description: Bounce-transition accuracy against an absolute limit, plus non-regression against the like-for-like reflected constant-motion baseline that uses the identical public boundary policy. A relative-improvement criterion against raw constant motion is deliberately not used: it measures the programmed reflection transform, and the fair baseline is analytically exact so no learner can improve on it.

gates.name: speed_change_frozen_robustness
gates.description: With updates disabled, the candidate's 50-transition post-event error does not regress against the reflected constant-motion baseline. This is a robustness control. It is not evidence of online adaptation, because the candidate is frozen.

gates.name: changed_law_adaptation
gates.description: In the matched changed-law experiment the updating copy must beat its identical frozen copy and persistence on 50-transition cumulative error by the declared margin, and must not regress against constant motion. The unavoidable first surprise prediction is included in every total.

gates.name: unchanged_control
gates.description: Continuing to update in an unchanged world must not degrade the model relative to its frozen twin.

gates.name: recovery
gates.description: Eligibility is defined by the peak post-event shock; every episode falls into exactly one status and unrecovered events are counted, never dropped.

gates.name: always_online_stability
gates.description: A single continuously updating instance operating across regimes with no evaluator mode switching must not regress against the reflected constant-motion baseline.

gates.name: speed_extrapolation_report
gates.description: Reported out-of-distribution accuracy above the training speed range. Informational: a failure here is recorded, not treated as an acceptance failure.

gates.name: correctness
gates.description: The retained evidence is complete, internally consistent, schema-valid, checksum-valid, and recomputes to the stored summary.

gates.name: reproducibility
gates.description: An independently initialized duplicate mini experiment, a save/resume equivalence check and a golden seed-mapping fixture are actually executed and compared. A deterministic seed function compared with itself is not accepted as evidence.

gates.name: cpu_usability
gates.description: The selected candidate itself is benchmarked for predict, update and combined latency on the recorded CPU.

latency.description: Measured on the selected candidate with a representative trained state and a representative valid input distribution, excluding plotting and disk I/O.

baselines.persistence: isolates the value of any motion model at all
baselines.constant_motion: isolates analytic first-order motion extrapolation with no boundary knowledge
baselines.constant_motion_reflected: isolates analytic motion extrapolation plus the identical public boundary policy the candidate is allowed to use; the like-for-like comparison
baselines.zero_control: the candidate architecture with zero-initialized parameters; isolates what the architecture predicts before any learning
baselines.candidate_frozen: the selected candidate with updates disabled; isolates what was learned during training
baselines.candidate_online: the selected candidate with updates enabled; isolates the contribution of continued updating
baselines.candidate_no_reflect: the selected candidate with the boundary policy removed; isolates how much of any bounce advantage is the reflection transform
baselines.legacy_linear_sgd: the historical v1 learner, retained as a diagnostic comparison only

notes.scope: AAA is a small, inspectable research prototype. Nothing in this benchmark supports a claim about general intelligence, physical understanding, or independent goal formation.
notes.boundary_policy: Reflection is programmed public knowledge of the observation format supplied by the programmer. It is not discovered by the learner.
notes.oscillator_exposure: The candidate is allowed to learn the pre-change oscillator dynamics from observations during the common prefix. Only the changed coefficients and the intervention itself are held out.
notes.bouncing_ceiling: Reflected constant motion is analytically exact on this deterministic noiseless world, so the bouncing family cannot show a learner outperforming it. The family is retained as an accuracy and non-regression check.
notes.leakage: Predictors receive only past observations and, after scoring, the revealed target. Scenario, event flags, velocities, change timing, change factors and hidden coefficients never enter a predictor.
